author: GameSpot
description:
We made our own version of Guess Who using Capcom characters and called it Guess Hugh. Then we brought in Leon S. Kennedy actor Nick Apostolides and Hugh Williams (Pragmata) actor David Menkin, and made them play against each other... with GoPros attached to their heads.

#pragmata #residentevil #capcom #voiceactor

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/6861411-GameSpot-Official/
title: Leon Kennedy & Hugh Williams Actors Play Capcom Guess Who
